subject: ALLOCATE statement
notes: LANDED (kb/Work PB151): the not-available leg EXISTS - CobolPtr.Allocate carries the Free-twin out-flag (GR5a/b: NULL into every address the statement assigns; GR5c: the nonfatal EC-STORAGE-NOT-AVAIL reports through the checking-gated block, the EmitFree pattern, with RESUME honored). The two old failure shapes are both dead: checked((int)size) no longer throws an unhandled OverflowException (past-int.MaxValue is notAvail), and the emitter-side (long) narrowing is GONE - the size travels as the FULL Int128, so a 20-digit request can no longer WRAP into a small VALID allocation (the PB22 cast family's unswept sibling, swept). An OutOfMemory landing is the same notAvail. pb151_allocate pins HUGE=NULL + EC-STORAGE-NOT-AVAIL under >>TURN; the ambient EcBinder gate that was armed with no raise site now has one.
